cohort: Women who received donated oocytes (n = 26), women who received IVF/ICSI (n = 52), and women with spontaneous conception (n = 52)
finding: Women who conceived through oocyte donation had lower levels of fear of childbirth and pregnancy-related anxiety compared to those who conceived through IVF/ICSI, but similar levels to those with spontaneous conception.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was associated with mothers' satisfaction with the delivery only in the oocyte donation group, with those who had an acute operative delivery being the most dissatisfied.
